{{Top}}
{{Quote|I lost R2 in the field.''"<br />"''Well, R2 units are a dime a dozen. I'm sure you'll find a suitable replacement.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] talking about losing [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Downfall">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>}}
The '''decicred''', also known as a '''dime''', was a tenth of a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]].<ref name="SW Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/downfall-of-a-droid-trivia-gallery|text="Downfall of a Droid" Trivia Gallery|quote=Obi-Wan's use of the phrase 'dime-a-dozen' now reveals that there are dimes in the Star Wars galaxy. The word 'dime' means, literally, a tenth, suggesting that a dime is analogous to the previously established 'decicred,' worth a tenth of a credit.}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> Its value was considered minuscule. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] face was pictured on the obverse of the decicred, while the reverse side showed the [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]].

Children were able to purchase [[decicred-dreadful]]s with these monetary units.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Downfall of a Droid]]" uses the phrase "a dime a dozen,"<ref name="Downfall" /> and the game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] uses the phrase "stop on a dime."<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> The word root "dime" means literally a tenth, suggesting that a dime is analogous to the previously established "decicred," worth a tenth of a credit.<ref name="SW Trivia" />
